dialogues.speaker: Mischievous Aranara
dialogues.text: Knock-knock! It's Aranara! You found Aranara. Aranara openly showed up, and will openly exit the game!

dialogues.speaker: Mischievous Aranara
dialogues.text: Being found doesn't mean you lost the game! Nara successfully found Aranara. Aranara has been successfully found. It's a win for both, hehe.
